I changed `is_supported_version` in `mitmproxy/net/tls.py`. It now wraps the `set_min_proto_version` and `set_max_proto_version` calls in a `try/except SSL.Error` and returns `False` if either raises. On OpenSSL builds that refuse to set a given protocol version, that version is now reported as unsupported instead of crashing. The existing `recv()` probe below it is unchanged.

I didn't run the test suite or add a test.
